description: Research reports index for golang-exercises project

reports.title: Goroutines in Go - Comprehensive Deep Dive
reports.scope: History, design motivation, internal mechanics, problem-solving approach, and performance characteristics of goroutines
topics: Problems Goroutines Solve (thread overhead, callback hell, complex APIs)
Internal Mechanics (GMP model, stack management, scheduler algorithm, preemption)
Comparative Analysis vs. Java Threads and Async/Await
keyFindings: Stack growth is cheaper than overallocation (2KB initial vs 1MB fixed)
Preemptive scheduling (Go 1.14+) solves fairness with 10ms threshold
Goroutines enable readable concurrent code (eliminates callback hell)
Network I/O doesn't block OS threads (via epoll)
Memory model is simpler than traditional threading
reports.targetAudience: Go developers, systems programmers, people learning concurrency
unconditionalQuestions: Fine-grained preemption interaction with cgo signal handlers
Stack reallocation overhead for GB-sized heaps
Formal fairness guarantee specifics (p99, p999 latency)
